name: Danjin

tierList.prydwen: T3 Tower of Adversity, T3 Whimpering Wastes (Hybrid; flex Main DPS)

kit.intro: 4-star Havoc Sword dual-role unit, playable as a fast Hybrid buffer or an extended Main DPS. Resonance Skill has no cooldown and chains into a 'mark' combo (applies Incinerating Will, +20% DMG taken from Danjin) or a longer 3-Basic/3-Skill combo. Forte builds via Skill casts and spends 50%/100% HP-cost Heavy Attacks (Chaoscleave) that heal ~1/3 max HP; her attacks consume her own HP, making her a high-risk/high-reward pick.

skills.resonanceSkill: Crimson Fragment - Carmine Gleam into Crimson Erosion (mark combo) or Sanguine Pulse (long combo, no cooldown).
skills.forte: Serene Vigil - Ruby Blossom gauge; Heavy Attack 'Chaoscleave'/'Scatterbloom' at 50 or full 100+ stacks, heals Danjin.
skills.liberation: Crimson Bloom - rapid multi-hit Havoc DMG + Scarlet Burst.
skills.outro: Duality - next character gains 23% Havoc DMG Deepen for 14s.

bestWeapons: Emerald of Genesis (100%, best permanent/5-star F2P)
echoSet: Midnight Veil (better with heavy investment/5-star weapon)
Havoc Eclipse (Main DPS variant, Dreamless echo)

teams.name: Best Team (Hybrid)
teams.notes: Danjin's Outro is the best Havoc DMG buff for Havoc Rover and a strong option for Phrolova/Camellya.

teams.name: Best Team (Main DPS)
teams.notes: Cantarella+Danjin forms one of the strongest all-4-star DPS teams in the game, though Danjin's self-damage HP mechanic is punishing here.

rotation: Damage Dealer: Intro -> Crimson Erosion I-II -> Ultimate -> Carmine Gleam -> Basic P2-3 -> Sanguine Pulse I-III (x2) -> full-power Chaoscleave/Scatterbloom -> Echo (swap) -> Outro. Hybrid variant uses partial-power Heavy Attack for a shorter rotation.
communityNotes: Prydwen: strong F2P 4-star flex pick (Hybrid or Main DPS) with excellent parry/dodge-counter play and great Sequence scaling, but constantly drains her own HP which makes her inconsistent against multi-enemy pressure; currently outclassed by Sanhua as a Hybrid and by limited 5-stars as Main DPS.
